Build, check, then merge

The builder works in an isolated copy, attempts repairs when checks fail, and merges only after all required checks pass and the target is still unchanged. A failed attempt stays in history.

Apps can use selected open-source backend services through Spider. Native adapters and service installation are handled in the runtime.
